definitions.explanation: A grass-like rush plant whose dried stems are woven into the facing of tatami mats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{藺草|いぐさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{藺草|いぐさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There is a pleasant scent of rush.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{藺草|いぐさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}かせて→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The scent of the rush in a new tatami mat has a calming effect.

notes:
A rush plant whose dried stems are woven into the facing of ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧ (tatami mats). The fresh, grassy scent of new tatami comes from {藺草|いぐさ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {藺草|いぐさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: the scent of rush
- {藺草|いぐさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{織|お}る→織る：04373_oru⟧: to weave rush

USAGE:
Often written in kana (いぐさ). The main production area in Japan is Kumamoto Prefecture.
